ns2:section.sectionText: Internationalization of Education: Theory & Practice..... This course examines how internationalization occurs primarily through the nation-building and socializing aspects of education. We will examine the process of internationalization and differentiate it from 'Globalization', deconstructing this contested term. Using specific case studies we will explore the how nation's cope with the forces of internationalism through their educational systems, and the ways in which educational policy simultaneously strives for internationalization while subscribing to nationalistic forces resisting interdependence through 'domesticization'.
